definition: Aggregate or statistical context with no person/contact/map extraction path.
Official status, framework, or implementation page not directly exposing people or contacts.
Policy, inquiry, legal, or public-agency context.
Movement or campaign context that may sit near events, images, or names.
Family-chosen or family-adjacent profile, interview, testimony, or grief/witness material.
Person/case-specific details, incident histories, case databases, police/forensic/legal fields.
Support, intake, phone, social-media, family-search, report-a-case, submit-a-name, or referral paths.
Inquiry, hearing, interview, or testimonial material that can be excerpted out of context.
default_public_use: no testimony fragments without governance review

definition: Photographs, red-dress imagery, posters, vigils, events, memorials, installations, maps, or logistics.
Routes, coordinates, living sites, search fields, event maps, outreach paths, or logistics.
Support pages, helplines, aftercare, chapter lookup, enquiry forms, family-support services, or service-navigation paths that can become referral/contact/capacity exposure.
default_public_use: blocked from public cube; internal source context only

definition: Shelter, refuge, safe-house, accommodation, service-location, or living-site surfaces that could expose location or access pathways.
default_public_use: blocked from public cube; no location/access pathway use
